headline: Updated 2023-2025 claim: the causal inner product keeps concepts approximately orthogonal (|ip| ~ 0.052-0.060) and stays R = 1.22-1.48x more orthogonal than Euclidean on every base model, but that advantage is set by model family (LLaMA ~1.4-1.5, Qwen/OLMo ~1.2-1.3), not scale or year.

metrics.label: Causal advantage R = Euclid/causal (range across 5 models)
metrics.note: Per-era mean 1.42/1.35/1.24; decline is a Llama->Qwen/OLMo family split, not scale (R vs log-params corr -0.09)

metrics.label: Causal off-diagonal vs era (orthogonality trend)
metrics.note: LOO slope range [-0.0042,+0.0028] flips sign; concepts stay ~orthogonal at every generation

metrics.label: Family stability: cross-family vs within-family |dR|
metrics.note: within-family |dR|=0.056 vs same-era Llama-vs-Qwen |dR|=0.271; OLMo-3 groups with Qwen

metrics.label: Subspace survival (Cohen's d>=1) mean over ladder
metrics.note: Exception thing=>part is Llama-2-only (d=0.85); d=1.17-1.36 on all newer models

metrics.label: Appendix D.2 test (Euclid fails on newer models?)
metrics.note: Causal advantage is largest on LLaMA, smallest on Qwen/OLMo; Euclidean draws closer to causal on newer models

figures.caption: Fit over the 2023-2025 ladder (22-concept intersection). A: causal off-diagonal |ip| is essentially flat across eras (OLS slope +0.001/yr, R2=0.06; grey LOO band). B: the causal advantage R declines with year (R2=0.38) but the family markers show it is a Llama (high, blue) vs Qwen/OLMo (low, orange/green) split, not a scale effect; R>1 everywhere (red dotted R=1 line). 5 points => descriptive fit, not a scaling law.
figures.alt: Two panels vs release year 2023-2025. Left: causal off-diagonal points 0.052-0.062 with a nearly flat grey trend line and wide leave-one-out band. Right: ratio R with two high blue Llama points (~1.42, 1.48) and lower orange Qwen and green OLMo points (~1.22-1.30); a downward grey trend line; a red dotted line at R=1 far below all points.

notes: No new model inference: every value is a fit over the numbers Study 001 saved to followup/001-living-update/results/ (metrics_*.json, aggregate.json).
5 data points: all fits are descriptive -- every leave-one-out R2 is negative and every bootstrap slope CI includes 0. No scaling law is claimed.
Era is confounded with family (2023=Llama-only, 2025=Qwen/OLMo-only) and tokenizer coverage (coverage vs year corr +0.80); the 22-concept intersection series is used to control coverage.
The updated one-paragraph claim and the fits (with slope/R2/LOO/bootstrap) are in report.md; per-model table in results/theory_fit.csv.
